_readme: Inputs and state for the release pipeline (.github/workflows/release.yml).
yt_dlp            what the last release shipped. The workflow writes this itself,
AFTER a release succeeds, so a failed build can never mark a
version as shipped. This is the value the daily check compares.
deno              pinned. Bump deliberately when you want a newer deno.
ffmpeg            BtbN only serves a rolling 'latest' tag, so this cannot be pinned
to an immutable URL. ffmpeg_last_built records what was actually
used, so a change shows up as a diff line.
ffmpeg_variant    'win64-gpl' is a full static build: two self-contained 145 MB exes.
'win64-lgpl-shared' is far smaller (~129 MB total instead of ~291 MB)
because ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe share one set of DLLs instead of
each carrying its own copy. Switch, then run the workflow as a dry
run and check that both video and audio downloads still work.
ffmpeg_last_built written by the workflow after each build.
